description: This file defines the Debug class within the Opencart\Catalog\Controller\Event namespace, which handles performance timing for specific routes by logging execution time before and after route processing.

classes.name: Debug
classes.description: A controller class for debugging, measuring route execution time and logging it.

methods.name: before
methods.description: Records the start time for a given route in the session data.

methods.name: after
methods.description: Calculates elapsed time for a route and logs it, then clears debugging session data.
